name: AgriSky
tagline: Drone crop-health maps and spray only where the crop needs it
problem: Pesticide and urea are sprayed over the whole field, though stress is patchy
Wasted chemical costs money and harms soil, water and the sprayer's health
Stress shows from above days before the eye sees it
Imagery analytics tools are costly, online-only black boxes

stats.label: Indian farm holdings small/marginal (Agri Census 2015-16, approx.)
MRP of a 45-kg bag of subsidised urea (approx.)

solution: Multispectral flights → NDVI/NDRE/NDWI maps and management zones
Explainable rules diagnose water stress, nitrogen deficiency or pest
Change detection warns when a pest patch starts spreading
Prescription + drone mission sprays only the zones that need it

features.title: Crop-health maps
features.desc: NDVI, NDRE, GNDVI, SAVI, NDWI, colour-IR and ΔNDVI heat maps

features.title: Zones + diagnosis
features.desc: k-means zones, rule trace per zone, 98.6% accuracy on unseen fields

features.title: Early warning
features.desc: Pest front speed, √area trend and days until it covers 10% of crop

features.title: Variable-rate Rx
features.desc: Spot spray + urea by NDRE deficit: ~89% pesticide saved, ₹ shown

features.title: Spray mission
features.desc: Boustrophedon lanes, fewest turns, tank/battery sorties, animated

features.title: Farmer report
features.desc: Printable English + Tamil report, CSV and GeoJSON export

architecture: Browser UI -> vanilla JS, canvas maps, SVG charts, path animation
app.py -> stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON API, validation
field.py -> seeded 4-band field generator with ground truth
analysis -> indices, masks, k-means, mode filter, components
classify / change -> rule list, ΔNDVI, spread trend, alert
prescription / planner -> VRA doses, coverage path, sorties
algorithms: NDVI / GNDVI / NDRE / SAVI / NDWI – vegetation and water indices
k-means++ with restarts – management zones on crop cells
Mode filter + connected components – clean, contiguous zones
Ordered rule list vs reference canopy – explainable diagnosis
ΔNDVI + p90 front advance + OLS on √area – spread rate, warning
Boustrophedon coverage + orientation search – fewest turns, sorties
innovation: Diagnosis explains itself: every rule, value and threshold shown
Plans the drone path from the prescription, not just a map
Warns on spread speed, not only on today's damage
Fully offline on a ₹15k laptop, Tamil farmer report

results.label: zone accuracy vs truth, 20 unseen fields × 5 flights
target cells sprayed exactly once, every field

demo_flow: Open dashboard on phone + projector, Wi-Fi off
Play Weeks: pest patch grows from the corner
Flight 5: red early warning, 0.9 m/day, 10% in ~4 days
Click the pest zone: read the rule trace
Run demo: drone flies 1 sortie vs 2 for whole field
Print the English + Tamil farmer report
impact: Less pesticide and urea per spray round lowers input cost
Less chemical reaching soil, channels and groundwater
Less operator exposure: drone sprays only small patches
Earlier pest action can limit crop loss (illustrative)
business: Per-acre service for drone operators and custom hiring centres
SaaS for FPOs / agri-input dealers to plan spray rounds
B2G: crop-health monitoring for KVKs and agriculture departments
Add-on prescription export for drone and sprayer makers
future: Real multispectral imagery (orthomosaic import, calibration panels)
Train the rules / a Naive Bayes on field-scouted labels
Nozzle-section control to cut edge overspray
Weather-aware spray windows (wind, rain) and drift buffers
